D63·w8ar — 2026-10-13
chose: 7.3 carry-forward: a fresh lanes run carries the newest earlier base that HEAD is an ancestor of, plus, per task not done/dropped, the newest earlier task branch with commits past that start; this run's branch for the task is cut at that tip and the base is integrated at the task's first placement
over: Leaving the branch to the merge queue at landing alone, or carrying work only on --resume
because: Integrating at first placement means the session starts from the current base (a conflict is handed to it as a merge in progress, the D24 path), and a stopped run's work is never redone or left untracked
